name: Villainess Idolized By Everyone: Fervent Advent, Leisurely Lull
source:
Autumn winds bring you a short story collection


~Presents for Present Day - shop around for holidays with Azure~

~Gathering for Cadence - cuddle fluffy puppies with Fiore and Cherne~

~Passion for Science - make breakthroughts with Rodion and Sol~

~Appreciation for Silence - have a civilized discussion with Liebe and Verderald~

[From [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/vibe-check-fall]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
飒爽秋风为你送来一部短篇故事集：

～献给今日的礼物——与阿祖尔一起逛街选购节日好礼～

～律动小聚——与菲奥蕾和谢尔内一起抱抱毛茸茸的小狗～

～科学热忱——与罗季昂和索尔携手取得研究突破～

～静谧礼赞——与莉贝和维德拉尔德来一场彬彬有礼的对谈～

[摘自[url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/vibe-check-fall]itch.io[/url]]
